NVIDIA LOST $1.6 TRILLION IN MARKET VALUE! 📉

That’s almost the estimated value of SpaceX. And it happened in just a matter of weeks!

But did Nvidia actually lose $1.6 trillion in cash? 🤯

No. And this is where most people misunderstand stock market headlines.

When you hear that billions or trillions have been “wiped off” the stock market, what does that actually mean?

The answer lies in something called market capitalisation (market cap) — one of the most important concepts every investor should understand.

FOLLOW @InvestingForMummies for simple, practical explanations of the stock market, money and investing.
